scares.description: Diego surprises Eva as she opens a door.
A man wearing a purge mask shoulder charges Shane.
A loud explosion startles Eva and Cali.
Loud gunfire may startle some viewers.
Two paramilitary men break into the closet that Eva and Cali are hiding in.
There is a sudden cut to a door bursting open.
Leo sees Shane and Liz hiding in his car.
A bloodied man lunges at Liz.
A group of men ambush Leo after he climbs a fence.
There is some loud gunfire with several more bursts of gunfire occurring over the next few minutes.
Through Leo’s night vision googles we see a woman suddenly jump out in front of him.
Loud gunfire occurs as Shane and Liz are talking.
Leo is shot as he walks out of the house.
